beijing_value_2.text: Another great thing to do in Beijing is to rent a bicycle at Mingshui Lake and try a bowl of sesame noodles at noon.

beijing_value_3.text: One more great thing to do in Beijing is to climb Taolin Hill and drink a glass of pear juice at sunrise.

shanghai.text: The best thing to do in Shanghai is to take a walk in Jinhua Garden and have a cup of Matcha in the morning.
